name: Luxury Picnics
short: Beautifully styled picnics designed around the setting, the occasion and the people you love.
statement: A long afternoon, a linen table and nowhere else to be.
intro: An elegant and intimate picnic, thoughtfully curated down to the smallest detail.
We choose the setting with you — a quiet stretch of beach, the shade of a cork oak, the edge of a pool — and style it around the occasion, so that all you have to bring is the people you love.
included: Styling and set-up in the location you choose
A low table dressed in linen, with cushions and blankets
Food and drink chosen for the occasion

seo.title: Luxury picnics in Comporta and Portugal · Picnic Club
seo.description: Beautifully styled luxury picnics on the beach, under the cork oaks or by the pool in Comporta, Tróia, Melides and Lisbon.
